title: Paradise
text: Starting the very next day, I began hatching the Filolial-sama and their kind and devoted myself to leveling them up. Spending my days hunting on a different island each day—it’s truly rewarding.

If I had to name one drawback, it’s that the Dragon Hourglass is so far away that I hit a level cap at Lv. 40. I did consider traveling to a place where I could use a portal to reach the Hourglass, but since it was impossible to bring a hundred people with me, I gave up on that idea.
“Um… Motoyasu-kun.”
“What is it?”

A few days later, my Father called out to me as I was surrounded by the Filolial-sama. Feeling great, I replied with my best smile. At that moment, it wouldn’t have been strange if my teeth had sparkled.
“It’s fine to raise the Filolial-sama deep in the island’s interior, but… I hear that because you and your group have been hunting so much, the island’s ecosystem is starting to get out of balance.”
“Oh? Thanks to the revitalization, wasn’t it actually better that we hunted?”
“Let’s know our limits, shall we?”

The Filolial-sama ran off to the beach and were enjoying themselves however they pleased. How many were there…? At least there were enough Filolial-sama who’d become angels for us to have the beach all to ourselves. This really is paradise.
“Isn’t that a bit too many?”
“No problem at all!”
“That’s exactly why I’m saying this… We really need to set some limits, at least a little.”
“But…”
My Father is resting his hand on his forehead as he looks at the chicks of the Filolial-sama surrounding me.
“Did you hatch them all…?”
“That’s right! Unfortunately, there was no Filo-tan among them!”

Yes, this is a very unfortunate outcome. I do wonder how I’ll ever get to meet Filo-tan, but taking care of the hatched Filolial-sama is also important. I need to level them up quickly. They’re all my precious angels!
“Um, Yuki-chan, could you supervise everyone? Kou and Luna-chan too. I’ll ask Sakura-chan to help later as well.”
“Understood.”
“Got it!”
“Yeah.”
The older Filolial-sama are helping out, too. Now then, let’s keep leveling up and build a wonderful paradise.
“How’s your Father doing?”

“Well, things are going smoothly, I guess. He’s out hunting with Melty-chan and Lars-chan to hone his skills. We’re also re-examining any issues with our teamwork, and—just as Ren told us—we’re making sure they can fight even if someone other than me is in command.”

As expected of my Father—he’s immediately addressing the issues that arose from this incident. As for me, it seems Yuki-chan has heard about what happened and has been discussing it with my Father to some extent. Well, of course, I think I understand the coordination aspects as well.

Since my Father, Yuki-chan, and my Finacée are all a step ahead when it comes to leadership, I plan to take on a supporting role. After all, I was told that whenever I step in, everyone basically relies on me, so I’m not really suited for that kind of training. Apparently, Keel and the Assistant are learning those skills as well. However, I hear they’re teaching them not just like a junior like Ren, but to observe, listen, think, and then respond flexibly.
Also, my Finacée, who hasn’t completed Class Up yet, is reportedly repeating the process of raising her level to the cap of 40 and then applying talent enhancements.

Well, that’s how our days on the island passed. However, just as Father pointed out, Filolial-sama and I—who had been exterminating monsters deep in the island’s interior—ended up pushing the monsters in our hunting grounds to the brink of extinction, resulting in restrictions on hunting in those remote areas. At this rate, I won’t be able to make the 100 Filolial-samas any stronger. In fact, everyone’s level capped at 40, and we couldn’t even improve their latent potential. My father, who came to check on us, said something like this:
“The island’s going to turn into a barren wasteland!”

Well, we did manage to collect a decent number of island boss drops. As for the penguin costumes my father had… for some reason, we only got one. I thought I remembered him saying we could turn this into a Filo-tan costume, so I planned to collect more, but…

On the contrary, it seems my Father managed to get a few while the island had an entry restriction in place. It makes me wonder if there’s a difference in the drop rates. This is what’s commonly known as the “greed sensor.”

Ren and Itsuki were pretty quiet during that time—I guess they were just doing a bit of hunting on another island. It’s probably because Itsuki and his friends had already reached a level range where they no longer needed to stay on the island, having hunted with me and Yuki-chan and the others.

As for Ren, since he’d originally been leveling up by exterminating monsters, this was probably his final push to reach the next tier. A few days later, he seemed to have plenty of free time. However, he appeared to be avoiding us, as if he didn’t want to run into us at all.
“It’s good that high-level and low-level adventurers keep to their own separate areas…”
As the Filolial-sama were growing up, my Father muttered this to me while gazing out at the island’s surroundings.
“Motoyasu-kun. Do you understand the concept of ‘everything in moderation’?”
“Adventurers rarely venture into the island’s interior. I was just hunting monsters in those remote areas.”
“I get where you’re coming from. But… you went too far.”
My Father gave me a stern talking-to. Still, I managed to level up all of Filolial-sama and her companions to a certain level.
“Now it’s just a matter of improving their aptitudes and raising their overall stats.”
“Since it might bother ordinary adventurers, let’s do that after we leave the island, okay?”
My Father grabbed my shoulder and asked me that. Well, I seem to recall my Assistant saying something about monsters having lives of their own, too.
“Man… there sure are a lot of them now.”

The panda beastman muttered as he watched the Filolial-samas playing on the beach. Is that really the only thought that comes to mind when seeing the Filolial-samas playing so happily, giggling away? Oh! I spotted my Finacée having a great time playing with the Filolial-samas. I’m going to join in, too!
“Finacée! Let me join in, too!”
“Here he comes again! Don’t keep barging in on us every time we’re playing!”
My Father was discussing the situation with the Panda Beastman.
“It’s turned into a huge group, but what are we going to do from here on out?”
“There’s not much to do—except in emergencies… I suppose we’ll have Yuki-chan and the others oversee them and have them carry out activities in various parts of the country.”
My father is subtly considering future operational policies for Filolial-sama.
“Like having them quell trouble before it starts, or securing supply routes. Or maybe helping out with business operations at Elena’s place.”
“I see. But… seeing little girls and Filolials taking over the beach like this is, well, a sight to behold—or rather, a bit eerie.”
“I’ve caught a glimpse of just how terrifying Motoyasu-kun’s ambitions are. And apparently, he plans to add even more.”
“Even with this many, he still wants more? Heroes really are a strange bunch, aren’t they?”
“Being lumped in with that guy is a bit…”
“Aren’t you going to play with that cool older sister, too?”
Keel is swimming using the doggy paddle. Behind him, Luna-chan is diving along like a shark, following close behind. Her tail is sticking out of the water. She’s beckoning the panda Beastman over.
“If this were a movie I’d seen in my world, Keel would be shark bait by now.”
“It’s a real downer to find out that Filolial, who likes that little mutt, is peeking in on us.”

It seems my father and the panda Beastman were sitting on the beach, basking in the twilight. Sakura-chan appears to be on her way to bring her Finacée a drink. She’s handing some out to my Father and the others as well. As for the Assistant… I heard he’s out in the open sea with Rival, observing the monsters in the water.

What a peaceful moment this is. The Lazy Pig is swaying in his hammock, sleeping as usual. It’s kind of gross that he’s wearing a swimsuit. I hear the Panda Beastman’s subordinates are having a good time drinking at the tavern.
“Oh, Lars-chan. That swimsuit looks good on you.”

The panda beastman is wearing a swimsuit while still in his panda form. Was that Father’s request, by any chance? He’s wearing a swimsuit that looks like a school swimsuit. There’s a patch sewn onto his chest.

The panda pattern on the panda looks a bit odd, but does Father think it suits him? I seem to recall he was reluctant when we tried to make him wear a two-piece swimsuit… On the other hand, Keel is swimming energetically while wearing a fundoshi.
“You won’t get anything out of me just by complimenting me.”
“That’s not exactly what I meant. Well then, why don’t you try a more attractive swimsuit?”
“That’s why I told you not to try to dress me up!”
“You’ve got a great figure, so I think you should show it off. When you dress up, Lars-chan, you become so beautiful and cute—it’s like a completely different person.”
“D-don’t try to flatter me like that!”
“Oh, really?”
The panda beastman looks a bit embarrassed. I don’t think you and Father are a good match. Oh, Father tucked a tropical flower into the panda beastman’s fur to use as a hair ornament.
“S-stop it! Don’t treat me like a toy.”
“I’m not.”
Even though she’s clearly annoyed, the panda beastman doesn’t take the flower out. …I wonder why? This feels familiar somehow.

Maybe it’s because of the panda beastman’s pattern, but I get a strong sense of déjà vu, as if my Big Sister’s older sister were standing right next to my Father. My Big Sister’s Big Sister and my Father had a strange relationship, didn’t they? My Big Sister’s Big Sister would tease my Father in a mature, noncommittal way, while my Father would respond as if he were getting a little worked up. It’s almost as if the dynamic between my Father and the Panda Beastman right now is the exact opposite.
Well, with our leveling progress hitting a plateau like this, we spent our time on the island keeping an eye on Ren and Itsuki’s movements.
